title: 登高
author: 杜甫
intro: An old, sick Du Fu climbs a height above the Yangtze on the autumn festival day. Endless falling leaves, an endless river, and a lifetime of wandering pour into eight lines often called the finest seven-character regulated poem in Chinese.
analysis: 重阳节有登高的习俗。这一年杜甫五十多岁，漂泊在长江边的夔州，又老又病，独自登上高处。前四句写景：秋风急，天很高，猿猴叫得悲哀；水中小洲清清的，沙滩白白的，鸟在空中盘旋。接着是最有名的一联：无边无际的落叶萧萧地飘下，望不到头的长江滚滚地流来。落叶让人想到生命一天天老去，长江让人想到时间永远不停，景色写得非常壮阔，又非常悲凉。后四句写情：离家万里，常年作客他乡，又遇上让人伤感的秋天；一辈子多病，今天只能一个人登台。艰难苦恨让鬓发全白，因为病又刚刚戒了酒，连借酒消愁都不行了。这首诗八句都对仗（上下句结构相同、意思相对），却读起来很自然，所以被称为“古今七言律第一”。
analysisEn: On the Double Ninth Festival (the ninth day of the ninth month), people climb a height. In 767 Du Fu, in his mid-fifties, sick and far from home in Kuizhou on the Yangtze, climbs alone. The first half is landscape: a sharp wind, a high sky, the mournful cry of gibbons; a clear islet, white sand, birds circling back. Then the couplet everyone knows: “Boundless forests shed their leaves, rustling down; the endless Yangtze comes rolling on.” Falling leaves suggest a life running out; the river suggests time that never stops. The scene is grand and heartbreaking at once. The second half turns inward. “Ten thousand li from home, grieving at autumn, always a guest; a hundred years of illness, climbing the terrace alone” — every phrase adds another layer of sorrow. Hardship has turned his temples frost-white, and illness has just made him give up wine, so even drinking away his sorrow is denied him. All four couplets are in strict parallelism (matching structure line against line), yet the poem flows naturally, which is why critics called it the best seven-character regulated verse ever written.
background: Du Fu (712–770) spent his last years drifting along the Yangtze. He wrote this in autumn 767 in Kuizhou (today’s Fengjie, Chongqing), three years before his death, when he was suffering from lung disease and other illnesses.
pronunciation: 潦倒 liáo dǎo（不读 lǎo）；渚 zhǔ；鸟飞回 huí（回旋）；萧萧 xiāo xiāo；鬓 bìn；作客 zuò kè。
version: 采用通行教材版本，无重要异文。

lines.py: fēng jí tiān gāo yuán xiào āi
lines.lit: Wind sharp, sky high, gibbons cry mournfully;
lines.en: Sharp wind, high sky, the gibbons’ cries are grief;

lines.py: zhǔ qīng shā bái niǎo fēi huí
lines.lit: islet clear, sand white, birds fly circling back.
lines.en: clear islet, white sand, birds wheeling back.

lines.py: wú biān luò mù xiāo xiāo xià
lines.en: Leaves fall without end, rustling, rustling down;

lines.py: bù jìn cháng jiāng gǔn gǔn lái
lines.lit: the endless Long River comes rolling on.
lines.en: the endless Yangtze comes rolling, rolling on.

lines.py: wàn lǐ bēi qiū cháng zuò kè
lines.lit: Ten thousand li away, grieving autumn, ever a guest;
lines.en: Ten thousand miles from home, sad autumn, always a stranger;

lines.py: bǎi nián duō bìng dú dēng tái
lines.lit: a lifetime of illness, alone I climb the terrace.
lines.en: a lifetime of sickness, I climb the terrace alone.

lines.py: jiān nán kǔ hèn fán shuāng bìn
lines.lit: Hardship and bitter regret — thick frost at my temples;
lines.en: Hard years and bitter regrets have frosted my hair;

lines.py: liáo dǎo xīn tíng zhuó jiǔ bēi
lines.lit: worn down, I have just stopped the cup of cloudy wine.
lines.en: broken down, I have just had to give up my wine.

words.en: to climb a height (a Double Ninth custom)
words.note: 重阳节登高的习俗今天还有。

words.en: (of animals) to cry long and loud

words.note: 这里是盘旋，不是“回家”的回。
古诗特有的说法，现代汉语说“落叶”。
现代汉语“滚滚长江”“财源滚滚”。
古诗常见主题：秋天让人感伤。

words.en: to live away from home as a guest
words.note: 古义指寄居他乡；今天“做客”指到别人家拜访。

words.en: temples thick with frost — i.e. white hair

words.note: 新：刚刚。杜甫晚年因肺病戒酒。
没有过滤的米酒，古诗常见。

imagery.name: 猿
imagery.zh: 秋风中猿猴的哀叫，一开头就定下悲凉的调子。
imagery.en: The gibbons’ mournful cries in the autumn wind set the sad tone from the first line.

imagery.name: 秋风
imagery.zh: 风急天高，是重阳登高时深秋的景象，也带出诗人“悲秋”的心情。
imagery.en: The sharp wind of late autumn frames the festival climb and brings on the poet’s autumn sorrow.

imagery.name: 长江
imagery.zh: 滚滚不尽的长江，象征永不停止的时间，反衬出人生短暂。
imagery.en: The endless rolling Yangtze stands for time that never stops — against which one life is short.

imagery.name: 霜
imagery.zh: “繁霜鬓”：满头白发像霜一样，写出艰难岁月留下的衰老。
imagery.en: Temples “thick with frost” — white hair, the mark of hard years.

imagery.name: 酒
imagery.zh: 本可以借酒消愁，却因病刚刚戒酒，愁苦无处排解。
imagery.en: Wine could have eased his sorrow, but illness has made him give it up — there is no escape.
